title: Specify the sad gate objective: what counts as prose doing work the code should do
description: Discussion outcome must land as an EARS spec (openspec proposal): deterministic detection of comment/doc strings that signal refactor-needed code; pre-hook + CI gate modes; language frontends; threshold config. Related: pretender (structural gates), vampiro (composition proofs).

comments.author: charly vibes
comments.text: Grill-me interview resolved the gate model (full rationale in the wai design artifact): purist stance for anti-agent guardrails; 4 checks (outside-channel comments, doc caps on pub API, unresolvable traceability markers, missing file header via require_header); exempt-but-observable principle with suppression_debt reporting; pretender-mirror output contract (--adopt baseline, stable finding IDs); hardcoded per-check remediation templates. Next: research phase (pinky/catitas) then openspec proposal.

acceptance_criteria: Panel definition + first published rates; documented decision rule for what evidence would falsify the premise
close_reason: Published docs/src/validation.md with panel definition, first measured rates (snapshot 2abebd0), pre-registered falsification signal/window, baseline-free measurement path; Rule-of-5 reviewed and fixed
